evidence: Ken Welch for Mayor | PO Box 16532, St. Petersburg, FL 33733. Political advertisement paid for and approved by Ken Welch for Mayor of St. Petersburg, Nonpartisan.

evidence: "Vote for Dave Bieter for Boise Mayor this November 3rd, 2015" ... "Paid for by Bieter for Boise, Frank Walker, Treasurer"
note: Incumbent mayor's own re-election site (bieter4boise.com) with Contribute and Volunteer pages and a committee footer. The model's "no" is the incumbent error. The only sample capture is from March 2016, after the election, but the page still shows the 2015 campaign content. Little doubt.

evidence: DONATE / SUPPORT STEVE; Request A Yard Sign; "Join Team Steve Today!"; "PAID FOR BY STEVE CARTER CAMPAIGN"
note: Captures from 9 and 24 Nov 2020 show donate, yard-sign and volunteer calls and a campaign committee footer, which means a live campaign for the 5 Dec 2020 runoff. The site is stevecarterforbr.com. The model said a different Steve Carter ran. I judge this wrong: the former state representative for District 68 was the Baton Rouge mayor-president candidate in 2020. This rests on my own knowledge, and I did not read more pages. The sample does not name the office explicitly. It asks for input on East Baton Rouge Parish issues, so a small doubt remains.

evidence: Cyndi Lamm for Mayor of Lincoln ... Cyndi Lamm is the Republican candidate for Mayor of Lincoln, Nebraska in 2019. Donate to Cyndi!
note: The supplied Aug 2019 sample is a critical site run after the election, which alone would not pass. A Nov 2018 capture of the same domain is her own campaign site with a donate call and 2019 election dates. The domain was later taken over by critics. Only the Nov 2018 capture, and any other in-window capture before the takeover, is a campaign site. The Aug 2019 capture is not.

evidence: Vision page: "The Scott administration embraces a Community Empowerment Model of neighborhood improvement"; "My administration will take a multifaceted approach to job creation"; "the foul odor of corruption hangs over Columbus"; footer "Paid for by Friends of Zach Scott."

The campaign committee footer and the platform content support a pass.

The captures from Oct and Nov 2016 show an active campaign with donate and volunteer calls. I did not confirm the full name John Frederick on the page. Low doubt.
